newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Nov 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Nov 19.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on the front page of its Tuesday edition:
- Half a million Rwandan refugees are still without international aid in the hills and valleys near Bukavu.
- A Central Intelligence Agency career officer charged with spying for Moscow allegedly offered himself to Russian intelligence two years ago.
- Secret documents from World War Two suggest Britain knew at an early stage about the Holocaust being perpetrated by Nazi Germany.
- The White House withheld details of the discussions President Bill Clinton had with a representative of an Indonesian family at the end of the recent U.S. presidential campaign.
- A former prosecutor is on the run from justice after being convicted of mail fraud, embezzlement and abuse of power.
- A jaw found in Ethiopia is being hailed as the most convincing dated fossil of the genus Homo.
